title: Create a purchase order
text: A purchase order is an order you send to a supplier. Stock does not change until the goods are received.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Click Create Purchase Order.
Choose the supplier. Mark it as Paid or leave it Unpaid and set a due date.
Add each product and enter the quantity and cost.
Click Save Purchase Order.
Choose Receive Now if the goods are already here, or Receive Later if they are still coming.

title: Save a purchase order as a draft
text: A draft saves your order without changing stock or prices. You can finish it later.
steps: While building the order, click Save as Draft.
To find it later, click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Set the Status filter to Draft.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Edit Purchase Order.
Finish it and click Save Purchase Order.

title: Receive a delivery
text: Receiving is the step that adds stock. Enter what actually arrived so a short delivery is easy to record.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Set the Status filter to To Receive.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Receive Items.
Type the quantity received on each line, or click Receive All.
Add the batch number and expiry date if the product has one.
Click Receive Now. Any shortage stays open as Partially Received.

title: Receive the goods while creating the order
text: If the goods are already here, you can receive them while you create the order. The order saves first, and then the receiving form opens.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Click Create Purchase Order and fill it in as usual.
Click Save Purchase Order, then choose Receive Now.
Type the received quantities, batch numbers, and expiry dates.
Click Receive Now again. The Receiving Report opens so you can print it.

title: Pay a supplier for an order
text: Record Payment logs what you paid the supplier. The Balance column shows the remaining amount owed.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Find the order.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Record Payment.
Type the amount, payment method, and date. Add a reference, note, or receipt photo if needed.
Click Save.
To see past payments, choose Payment History from the same menu.

title: Print a purchase order or receiving report
text: View Purchase Order shows the order you sent. Receiving Report shows what arrived compared with the original order.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Click the arrow at the end of the order row.
Choose View Purchase Order for the order document.
Choose Receiving Report after something has been received.
Print it or save it as a PDF from the preview.

title: Delete a purchase order
text: You can delete an order before it is received, even if you already paid for it. A received order cannot be deleted.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Find the order.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Delete Purchase Order.
Confirm. If the option is missing, the delivery was already received.

title: Find an old purchase order
text: Use the filters together to narrow a long list. Each branch keeps its own orders, so choose the branch first.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Purchase Orders.
Type the PO number, reference, or supplier name in the search box.
Set Status to To Receive, Partially Received, or Draft.
Choose a supplier in All Suppliers or a date range in Select Period.
Click the row to open the order or use the action menu for more options.
